title: Correct the reward v2 Table I audit
summary: docs/REWARD_V2_TABLE1_AUDIT.md now states the TRAINING stationary-translation criterion as under 10% of the commanded tracking component for a motionless robot, and reports version 1, the paper's fixed 0.15 scale and a command-scaled kernel against it. Its CPU checks replace the earlier reference functions, which used the paper's 0.15 scale as the proposal.
